summary: iter-140.b verification (backend + frontend). Backend: ran the dev's iter-140 suites (14/14 pass) plus a NEW independent review suite of 11 tests for POST /api/admin/reconcile-double-deduct covering past-day double charge (sub-wallet-only credit), today/future early-tick (BOTH users.wallet_balance and subscriptions.wallet_balance credited), mixed past+today on one sub, delta top-up idempotency, fully-refunded skip, no-tick past day (no refund), meals clamp, dry_run purity and auth guards — 11/11 pass (25/25 combined). Frontend: AdminUsers refund panel preview shows 'Pending refund: Rs.100.00 + 2 meal(s) across 1 day(s)', apply flow succeeded and DB verified (user 800->900, sub 800->900, meals_used 4->2, ledger reason 'early-tick', meals_delta=2). Kiosk face ring verified with an injected face-api stub (preview Chromium has no WebGL/WASM so the real models cannot init here): an off-center / far-left face inside the oval now turns the ring emerald (data-aligned=1) in ~182ms and stays green for 6s+, auto check-in POST fires; too-far -> 'Move closer to the camera', too-close -> 'Step back a little', no-face -> 'Look at the camera to check in', all red. No regressions found.

minor.issue: Full-collection scan: `db.wallet_transactions.find({})` iterates EVERY ledger row on every call (dry_run and apply). Add a server-side filter ($or on reason ^'Scan · ' / ^'Daily deduction · ' plus kind='double_deduct_refund') and an index on (kind, refund_date) / reason before this is used on a large production ledger.

meals accounting inconsistency: meals_restore_total is clamped to sub.meals_used, but each ledger row still writes the UNCLAMPED r['meals_restore'] into meals_delta. If a sub had fewer meals_used than owed, the idempotency ledger over-reports restored meals and the residual is never topped up on a later run (verified via TestMealsClamp: meals_used 1 -> 0, refund Rs.100 correct, response meals_restored=1 while ledger meals_delta=2).

Audit trail: for past-day (sub-only) refund rows the ledger `balance_after` is set to the USER wallet balance (unchanged), not the sub wallet the money actually landed in — misleading for reconciliation.

design_issues.screen: Admin > Users & Roles — double-deduct refund panel
issues: Apply-refund confirm() copy is stale: it still says the tool 'credits back per_meal x scans for each day where BOTH a scan and a midnight full-day debit were logged' — it no longer describes the today/future early-tick full-day refund path that iter-140.b added.
Long status messages wrap to 2 lines and the second line is visually clipped by the tile's overflow-hidden bottom edge (e.g. 'No subscribers enrolled yet · enroll from Profile page').

Write the CLAMPED meals value into the refund ledger's meals_delta so the delta-idempotency ledger matches what was actually applied.
Refresh the Apply-refund confirm() copy in AdminUsers.jsx to mention the early-tick (today/future) full-day refund.
Optional: stop the kiosk face status bar from clipping its second line.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_reconcile_double_deduct iterates the entire wallet_transactions collection in Python; O(total ledger) per admin click — filter server-side.
Ledger meals_delta uses the unclamped owed meals while the applied restore is clamped to meals_used → residual meals can be permanently lost to idempotency.
Refund credit for past-only days lands on subscriptions.wallet_balance but the ledger row records the user wallet's balance_after.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (refund panel preview+apply, face ring green/red states)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Face-api CANNOT run in this preview Chromium (no WebGL, tfjs-wasm .wasm 404s from the CDN) — the real detector never becomes ready and the tile shows 'Recognition models loading · retry N'. To test the kiosk ring, install a face-api stub with page.add_init_script BEFORE navigation, and IMPORTANT: the script string must be an IIFE `(() => {...})();` (a bare arrow-function expression silently does nothing). Stub shape: window.faceapi = {nets:{tinyFaceDetector|faceLandmark68Net|faceRecognitionNet:{loadFromUri:async()=>{}}}, TinyFaceDetectorOptions:function(){}, detectSingleFace:()=>({withFaceLandmarks:()=>({withFaceDescriptor:async()=>({descriptor:Float32Array(128), detection:{box:{x,y,width,height},score}})})})} and defineProperty it so the CDN UMD bundle can't clobber it. Also: face tile only renders after the kiosk Voice toggle (data-testid=kiosk-voice-toggle) is ON. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter140b_refund_review.py.
rca_of_the_issue: Both iter-140.b fixes verified as effective. Refund tool: per-day over_charge = tick_charged for today/future (credits BOTH users and subscriptions wallets) and = scan_charged for past days with a tick (credits sub only); already-refunded amount/meals are subtracted so a re-run tops up a partial refund (40 -> +60) and returns zero candidates once whole. Face ring: alignment now depends only on detected face width in [0.08,0.90] of the frame, so the object-cover scaling mismatch that kept an on-screen-centered face outside the old raw-frame TARGET_BOX can no longer keep the ring red; 400ms tick gives ~180ms perceived transition.
